sourceTrace.authority: Habit Lab™ Learner Workbook — Production Master
sourceTrace.notes: Phase 1 player map traced to the frozen workbook and existing canonical HAB field registry. The executable evidence runtime remains authoritative during the vertical-slice transition.

school.label: School Edition
school.privacySummary: You decide what to share with peers. Facilitator access is limited to what is needed to support learning and safeguarding.

emerging_adult.label: Emerging Adult Edition
emerging_adult.privacySummary: Private reflections are not automatically shared with peers, employers or programme administrators.

workplace.label: Workplace Edition
workplace.privacySummary: Individual evidence is private. Organisational reporting is aggregated and separated from personal reflections.

sessions.title: The Hook
sessions.mission: Meet someone whose habits changed everything.

blocks.title: The boy who kept losing R20
body: Sipho keeps taking the same route, entering the same shop and spending the same R20 before he has properly decided.
Then a broken radio gives him a different loop: challenge, curiosity, try. One repeated pattern costs him; another begins to build something.

blocks.title: Make a prediction
body: What do you think happens next for Sipho? Your prediction remains part of the story; your own prediction accuracy is measured later.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Predict what happens next for Sipho

blocks.title: Pause
body: Close the handbook for 30 seconds. Ask: What surprised me most so far?

sessions.title: The Pattern
sessions.mission: Name one repeated pattern and find evidence that it exists.

blocks.title: Find evidence
body: Choose a repeated pattern and one trace from the last seven days that could show it happened. Evidence can reveal what memory smooths over.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Capture evidence of a repeated pattern

blocks.title: Look beneath the obvious reward
body: Ask what the pattern gives you, including relief, escape, control, numbness or avoidance.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Reflect on obvious and less obvious rewards

sessions.title: The Revelation
sessions.mission: Discover the hidden structure of a habit.

blocks.title: The habit loop
body: Cue → Routine → Reward
A pattern repeats because it produces a payoff, even when the payoff also carries a cost. Once the loop is visible, it can be tested.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Understand the cue routine reward model

blocks.title: Once is evidence
body: Sipho still wants the sweets. He buys screws instead. Once is not a new habit, but once is evidence that another routine is possible.

sessions.title: Habit Mapping
sessions.mission: Map the structure of one real habit as carefully as you can.

blocks.title: Map the loop
body: Identify the cue, routine, obvious reward, less obvious reward, cost, people affected, environment and a possible replacement routine.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Map the structure of your selected habit

blocks.title: Add diagnostic evidence
body: Record the emotion, person and yesterday count that might help explain when the pattern appears.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Capture diagnostic evidence for the habit map

sessions.title: Behaviour Equation
sessions.mission: Write a working explanation that can be challenged.

blocks.title: Working Behaviour Equation
body: Cue + Old Routine → Cost
Cue + New Routine → Similar Reward + Lower Cost
This is a hypothesis, not a verdict.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Write and rate a working behaviour equation

blocks.title: Falsification test
body: Name what you would see if your explanation were wrong and what evidence would make you revise it.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Define evidence that could disprove your equation

sessions.title: Behaviour Contract
sessions.mission: Design a seven-day test of your working equation.

blocks.title: Design the experiment
body: Choose the habit, replacement routine, cue, reward, witness, restart plan, minimum version and failure signal. Predict your adherence before the experiment begins.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Set up the seven day Habit Lab experiment

sessions.title: 7-Day Experiment
sessions.mission: Notice the first target opportunity each day and record what happens.

blocks.title: Daily evidence
body: Each day, record whether the cue occurred and whether you used the replacement routine. No opportunity is not the same as failure.

blocks.title: Day 3 checkpoint
body: Review surprises, difficulty and evidence. Adjusting the test is calibration; the experiment version must remain visible.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Complete the day three calibration checkpoint

blocks.title: Prediction accuracy
body: Prediction accuracy = 100 − |predicted adherence − actual adherence|. If no opportunities occur, record N/A rather than zero.

sessions.title: Evidence Review
sessions.mission: Review what supported and challenged your explanation.

blocks.title: What changed?
body: Compare Habit Control and Equation Confidence before and after the experiment. A negative or zero shift is still evidence.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Review pre and post Behaviour Evidence Indicators

blocks.title: Harvest the evidence
body: Identify what supported the equation, what challenged it, and which assumption became harder to defend.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Reflect on evidence from the seven day experiment

sessions.title: Behaviour Profile
sessions.mission: Bring your evidence, experiment and updated understanding together.

blocks.title: Behaviour Profile Summary
body: The profile brings together the pattern, loop, equation, falsification test, impact, adherence and shifts without turning evidence into a label.
blocks.accessibilityLabel: Review the completed Behaviour Profile Summary

blocks.title: Investigation complete
body: This is not a certificate of perfection. It is evidence that you completed and reviewed a behavioural investigation.
